description.value: The Greek Corner is a locally owned, award-winning Greek restaurant in Surrey serving traditional dishes such as souvlaki, moussaka, spanakopita, and slow-roasted lamb. The restaurant offers licensed liquor service with Greek wines and cocktails alongside a full dine-in experience in a Mediterranean-inspired atmosphere. Their catering arm handles events from small gatherings up to 700 guests, reflecting an established presence in the community.
